messages:
emma_cs: Quick heads-up — Curie Energy renewal hit a snag. Procurement uploaded PO but it’s in EUR and missing the local VAT ID. They say they need the subsidiary VAT shown on the invoice or treasury won't release funds. :grimacing:
luke_account: They already asked for a 10% discount citing a missing data connectors feature. Are we bending on price for VAT paperwork?
nina_billing: VAT ID is mandatory for EU invoices. We can re-issue in EUR with VAT lines, but our billing system expects customer currency to match the contract currency. What's the signed currency on the renewal doc?
emma_cs: Signed renewal doc states USD for pricing, customer submitted PO in EUR. Procurement message: "Supplier must invoice in EUR or we can't route through local AP."
jeremy_legal: Two things: 1) we can put an amendment that allows invoicing in EUR for this customer (one-off), and 2) we should capture an explicit acceptance of the discount request in the amendment to avoid scope creepage. I'll draft.
amanda_onboard: Enablement is blocked until AP confirms invoice — customer won't release onboarding budget without invoice showing VAT. We had tentatively booked next Wed for kickoff. Need to pause until billing confirmed.
onboarding-bot: Remind: training slot held for Curie Energy on 2026-06-09 10:00 — will auto-release in 48h if not confirmed.
finance-bot: New PO received: PO-CE-3321 (EUR 95,000)  vendor: CurieEnergy-EU  missing: VAT ID field
emma_cs: Customer (quoted): "We can only accept EUR invoice locally. VAT ID is: DE123456789. Also, the procurement lead says treasury will only pay parent wiring if invoice shows local VAT on the PDF."
luke_account: Two asks from buyer: (1) invoice in EUR with VAT ID, (2) 10% one-time discount because the connector we promised for Q3 is delayed.
nina_billing: If we invoice in EUR and apply 10% discount, we need a contract amendment specifying exchange-rate handling and that treasury will accept Redwood's USD banking with FX conversion. Otherwise our AR team won't process.
jeremy_legal: I'll prepare an amendment: currency change to EUR for invoicing only, VAT line inclusion, and explicit one-time discount clause. Also will add a sentence that the connector ETA remains Q3 and is not part of the renewal scope.
emma_cs: Can we keep pricing committed in USD but issue a EUR invoice equivalent? Customer wants that.
finance-bot: Note: AR workflow requires a mapped Currency Code (EUR) on the contract for invoice generation. Legal amendment must include currency override flag.
amanda_onboard: Can we offer a short-term workaround so onboarding isn't delayed? Maybe provisional invoice PDF with VAT ID and "Invoice Pending" note? Customer's AP needs a PDF to release first milestone payment.
luke_account: We could issue a provisional invoice (non-final) for the onboarding hold, then follow with the amended final invoice. What operational risk?
nina_billing: Provisional invoice ok if marked as pro-forma and zero balance. But AP teams usually want a payable invoice. We could issue the final invoice immediately once amendment is signed. That means getting DocuSign out today.
jeremy_legal: I'll fast-track the amendment draft and set signing order: 1) Curie subsidiary procurement, 2) Curie parent treasury, 3) Redwood. They insisted subsidiary must sign first last time.
emma_cs: OK please set up DocuSign. Also we need to capture the customer's feedback about the connector delay in our CS feedback tracker so PM sees it.
amanda_onboard: I'll log the feature ask and impact (blocking onboarding) in the feedback tracker and tag PM. Also I'll tentatively hold the training slot but note it's conditional on signed invoice PDF.
onboarding-bot: DocuSign envelope created: https://docusign.example.com/envelopes/ce-amp-789 (signing order configured).
finance-bot: Reminder: Invoice template for EUR must include VAT field and VAT ID. Will validate once amendment uploaded to DocuSign.
jeremy_legal: Draft uploaded to envelope. Please review: amendment includes 10% one-time credit applied to first renewal invoice, invoice-currency override to EUR for invoicing only, VAT ID clause, and feature exclusion language.
luke_account: Reviewing now. Quick check: does the 10% credit change renewal ARR baseline for future years? We need it explicitly one-time.
jeremy_legal: Yes explicitly one-time. Clause: "A one-time credit of 10% will be applied to the invoice described in this amendment and shall not alter the annual recurring charges."
amanda_onboard: Once signed and invoice PDF with VAT is available, I'll trigger AP handoff and confirm training.
emma_cs: Action items: Jeremy finalize & send envelope, Nina prepare EUR invoice template, Amanda log feedback and hold slot, Luke to email buyer to nudge signing. Everyone good?
all: :thumbsup:
(END)
